rule.absence_below_min_elapsed: absence at elapsed < MIN_HONEST_ELAPSED is recorded as too_early_to_conclude, NEVER as absence
rule.competition_verdict: UNION over probed fixtures, always reported WITH the denominator (fixtures probed, and the elapsed minute of each)
rule.governing_rule: Assert a non-zero COUNT, never a status code. An HTTP 200 carrying an empty payload is ABSENCE and is reported as absence.
rule.stats_present_means: len(response) > 0 AND at least one entry carries at least one statistic with a non-empty `type`
rule.xg_present_means: a non-against expected-goals type exists AND at least one of its values parses as a number; null/''/'-'/non-numeric is ABSENT, never zero
rule.xg_zero_handling: a parseable 0.0 is PRESENT-but-zero, recorded separately as xg_zero_valued; this probe cannot distinguish a genuine early-match 0.0 from a placeholder and does not pretend to
